T01_authority.locator: AXIAL -- joint centre = the web commissure projected on the finger axis
T01_authority.axis_definition: unit(THUMB_TIP_R.head - THUMB_CMC_R.head) of the frozen Stage4B joint frame; origin = THUMB_CMC_R.head of the same frame.  This is the pipeline convention already used for the accepted THUMB_MCP T-01 gate (it reproduces 43.300 mm exactly).

search_volume.cross_section_constraint: thumb-owned surface vertices within +/-1.2 mm of the slab plane and radial <= 1.3 x R_env(thumb) = 14.48 mm; candidates are the section centroid plus a polar interior grid at 0.25/0.50/0.75 x r95 (8 directions)
search_volume.ownership_constraint: nearest surface face owner must be THUMB
